timeline.title: Founded the Rotaract Club of Kitante
timeline.body: Part of the founding group that formed the club from nothing. We recruited members, built the meeting rhythm, and set up the structures that let it survive its first year.

timeline.title: Member, buddy group leader, board
timeline.body: Worked up through the club rather than into it. Buddy group leadership first, then board responsibility, which is where I learned that attendance records, dues tracking and reporting were quietly eating everyone's time.

timeline.title: President
timeline.body: Led the club through a full Rotary year: projects, fundraising, membership growth and the weekly discipline of actually showing up. Handed over to a successor with the structures in better shape than I found them.

timeline.title: Immediate Past President
timeline.body: Supporting the incoming leadership without running the club. It's a role that is mostly about restraint.

timeline.title: Incoming PIME Chair, District 9218
timeline.body: Planning, Implementation, Monitoring and Evaluation for a newly formed district of 68 clubs. Responsible for how the district plans its year, assesses club performance, and knows whether any of it worked.

lessons.title: Adoption beats features
lessons.body: A system nobody fills in is worse than a spreadsheet somebody does. Design for the tired volunteer at 10pm, not the power user.

lessons.title: Measurement changes behaviour
lessons.body: The moment you score something, people optimise for the score. Choose what you measure as carefully as how you measure it.

lessons.title: Handover is the real test
lessons.body: Anything that only works while you're there hasn't worked. Documentation and succession are part of the build, not an afterthought.

lessons.title: Data has consequences
lessons.body: Membership records hold real people. Data protection isn't a compliance box. It's the difference between trust and a scandal.

serviceBeyond.title: Community projects
serviceBeyond.body: Club-level service projects, fundraising and partnerships: the ordinary work that makes a club worth belonging to.

serviceBeyond.title: Mentorship
serviceBeyond.body: Designing a district-wide Rotary–Rotaract mentorship programme, so newer members get access to people who have done it before.

serviceBeyond.title: Digital infrastructure
serviceBeyond.body: Setting up the tools, donation pipeline and records that let volunteer organisations operate like real ones.

serviceBeyond.title: Governance
serviceBeyond.body: Assessment frameworks, reporting standards and the unglamorous documents that keep a district honest.

talks.title: Why good systems still fail
talks.body: Adoption, not features. What actually determines whether an organisation uses the tool you gave it, drawn from replacing paper sign-in sheets in real clubs.

talks.title: Measuring what matters
talks.body: Designing assessment frameworks that change behaviour in the direction you intended. What happens the moment you attach a score to something.

talks.title: Data protection is not a checkbox
talks.body: What membership records actually contain, what goes wrong when they leak, and how to build a system that survives scrutiny.

talks.title: Building for the volunteer
talks.body: Designing for people who are tired, unpaid, on a phone, and doing this at 10pm. The hardest user in software.

talks.title: From club to district
talks.body: Founding an organisation, leading it and handing it over. What transfers, and what doesn't.

talks.title: Shipping alone
talks.body: How one engineer takes a system from empty database to real users, and where that approach breaks down.

formats.title: Keynote or talk
formats.body: 20 to 45 minutes, with or without slides. Best for conferences, district assemblies and university audiences.

formats.title: Workshop
formats.body: Half or full day, hands-on. Teams leave with a document they wrote, not notes they'll never read.

formats.title: Panel
formats.body: Technology, civic organisations, youth leadership. I'm useful on panels where someone needs to say the unglamorous thing.

formats.title: Remote
formats.body: All of the above, delivered over video for audiences outside Uganda.
